text: {"items":[{"claim_id":"qa:greeting","reason":"The agent provided the company name, their name, and asked how they could help.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:identity_verification","reason":"The agent asked for the account number for verification before proceeding.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:empathy","reason":"The agent apologized for the connectivity problems in turn 3.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:no_prohibited_promises","reason":"The agent explicitly stated they could not fix the issue remotely and made no other promises.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"qa:proper_closure","reason":"The agent asked if there was anything else, summarized the outcome, and said goodbye.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"resolution","reason":"The agent could not find a cause or fix and only suggested monitoring the connection.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"churn","reason":"The customer expressed frustration and insults but never explicitly mentioned canceling or switching providers.","support":"supported"},{"claim_id":"reason:network","reason":"The customer explicitly mentioned having terrible network issues.","support":"supported"}]}
